verdict: Yes, as a focused accessory brand, not as a full clothing line. Heart Up My Sleeves opened Shark Tank India's first episode with detachable sleeves and got a deal. The product solves a real problem: turning sleeveless dresses and blouses into outfits for office, temple or family events. It is cheap to make and ships flat, so margins are good, but you will need a steady stream of new designs to keep buyers coming back.
angle: Many Indian women own sleeveless outfits they can't wear everywhere. Detachable sleeves let one garment work for more occasions, and they need no size-heavy inventory: most fit a range of arm sizes. That makes returns lower than for full garments. The risk is that the idea is easy to copy, so your brand, the fabrics and the fit have to be better than marketplace copies.

faq_extra.q: Do detachable sleeves need different sizes?
faq_extra.a: Most are made in two or three sizes with elastic or adjustable straps, far fewer than a full garment range. That keeps stock simple and returns low.
